boundary.description: From and E along Loud Bridge Rd near Fairclough Farm, Height Ln, Hesketh Ln, Rock Brow, Forty Acre Ln, then E onto unnamed road near Cardwell House to its bend, and then along track to Longridge Fell Trigonometric Point at Spire Hill on Longridge Fell OS658411. S passing between Lennox Farm and Plantation farm the Goodshaw House passing to the E of Dutton Manor to Dean Brow on the B6243. Then E along Dean Brown, Clitheroe Rd, Lower Rd to and west, then north along diocesan boundary to the Loud Bridge Rd.
